mapper.select: SELECT m.menu_id AS menuId, m.program_id AS programId, p.program_nm AS programNm, p.url_path AS urlPath, m.parent_menu_id AS parentMenuId, m.menu_nm AS menuNm, m.sort_order AS sortOrder, m.use_yn AS useYn FROM MENUS m LEFT JOIN PROGRAMS p ON m.program_id = p.program_id ORDER BY m.sort_order, m.menu_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MENUS (program_id, parent_menu_id, menu_nm, sort_order, use_yn, ins_id, ins_ip) VALUES (#{programId}, #{parentMenuId}, #{menuNm}, COALESCE(#{sortOrder}, 0), COALESCE(#{useYn}, 'Y'), #{insId}, #{insIp})
mapper.select: SELECT m.menu_id AS menuId, m.program_id AS programId, p.url_path AS urlPath, m.parent_menu_id AS parentMenuId, m.menu_nm AS menuNm, m.sort_order AS sortOrder FROM MENUS m LEFT JOIN PROGRAMS p ON m.program_id = p.program_id WHERE m.use_yn = 'Y' AND (p.program_id IS NULL OR p.use_yn = 'Y') AND ( m.program_id IS NULL OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ROLE_PROGRAMS rp WHERE rp.program_id = m.program_id AND rp.role_id = #{roleId} ) ) ORDER BY m.sort_order, m.menu_id
